query: user-centric agents co-evolve environment and user simulator
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — Exact match. Introduces a meta-agent that jointly adapts the agent, user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration.  
   **People:** Min Cai and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Xi Ye also Amii); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL** — Studies agents overfitting to fixed user simulators and proposes SCOPE, where policies and a population of user simulators co-evolve through training.  
   **People:** Simon Yu and Weiyan Shi (Northeastern); Nicholas Tomlin (NYU); Marwa Abdulhai and Sergey Levine (UC Berkeley); Ximing Lu (University of Washington); Derek Chong, Abe Hou, Dilara Soylu, and Christopher D. Manning (Stanford).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2608.12253](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.12253)

3. **GenEnv: Difficulty-Aligned Co-Evolution Between LLM Agents and Environment Simulators** — Co-trains an agent with a generative environment simulator that continually creates tasks near the agent’s current ability level.  
   **People:** Jiacheng Guo, Ling Yang, Jiahao Qiu, and Mengdi Wang (Princeton); Peter Chen (Columbia); Qixin Xiao and Xinzhe Juan (University of Michigan); Yinjie Wang (University of Chicago); Ke Shen (affiliation not specified in the paper).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2512.19682](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.19682)

4. **UserBench: An Interactive Gym Environment for User-Centric Agents** — Closely related benchmark and simulator work: users begin with underspecified goals and incrementally disclose preferences, testing whether agents clarify and adapt rather than merely execute tasks.  
   **People:** Cheng Qian (Salesforce AI Research and UIUC), Heng Ji (UIUC), plus Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Zhiwei Liu, Jianguo Zhang, Haolin Chen, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2507.22034](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.22034)

query: meta-agent modifies training environment during multi-turn reinforcement learning
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — Exact match. A meta-agent monitors multi-turn RL training and hot-swaps validated changes to the environment, user simulator, rewards, and RL configuration.  
   **People:** Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (Independent Researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Amii).  
   **URL:** [arXiv abstract](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **EAU full paper (PDF)** — Contains the framework, experiments, intervention history, and reported gains across UserGym, ColBench, and τ²-Bench.  
   **People/affiliations:** Same research team and institutions listed above.  
   **URL:** [arXiv PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16523)

3. **EAU project page** — Companion site referenced by the authors in the paper.  
   **People/affiliations:** Min Cai et al.; University of Alberta, NUS, Kuaishou Technology, independent research, and Amii.  
   **URL:** [EAU project site](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)
